title: Print Window Border Gap
description: Print windows have a small gap between the title bar first line and the window content box; borders should touch seamlessly.
summary: Completed the table window border repair: short-table headers and body rows now share a separator spanning the full window width, while the final hook restores the west frame. Added source regressions, verified the exact five-column table at 300 DPI in light and dark, and passed the quick and full 12-PDF Nx print suites.
